Prefer reject over accept when uncertain; a missed alias costs one empty cell. Mark hold_for_human when the change is broad or the evidence is thin. Any cross_commodity hit needs a written reason why the collision is benign, or a `modify` payload that tightens the pattern. absorbs_review + intended_capture are what the alias BUYS; a proposal with none of either is noise.
